UEG Week 2026: Young Co-Chair and three abstract presentations

Oct 17-20, 2026 · Barcelona, Spain

Summary

Faculty role. Young Co-Chair, moderated poster session Therapeutics in IBD: Real-world experience (I), Tuesday 20 October 2026, 11:30-12:30.

Presentations

  • Automated extraction of the Montreal classification from endoscopy reports with NLP and large language models (poster, Saturday 17 October).
  • Clear cell sarcoma of the gastrointestinal tract presenting as obscure gastrointestinal bleeding (clinical case poster UEG2026:1362, Saturday 17 October).
  • Liver stiffness by transient elastography in heart failure: linking hepatic congestion with echocardiographic findings (moderated poster, Tuesday 20 October).

Gastroenterology Fellow

Gastroenterology and hepatology fellow at Istanbul University, Istanbul Faculty of Medicine. My clinical work centres on inflammatory bowel disease and diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy; my research combines real-world cohorts with natural-language processing and AI-assisted analytics.
